capabilities: Auto-reveal the active file in the File Explorer on tab or file switch
Reveal files without transferring keyboard focus from the editor
Configure a debounce delay for reveals
extras: Not yet published to the Obsidian community plugin store; the README only covers installing from source (clone, build, symlink).
intentEvidence: The existing obsidian-reveal-active-file plugin uses Obsidian's built-in file-explorer:reveal-active-file command, which transfers focus
motivation: The author found that the existing obsidian-reveal-active-file plugin's focus transfer creates a race condition where pressing Delete after a file switch can delete the revealed file instead of editor content.
problem: Obsidian's built-in reveal-active-file command transfers keyboard focus to the File Explorer, so keys pressed right after switching files can act on the wrong file.

relations.evidence: The existing obsidian-reveal-active-file plugin uses Obsidian's built-in file-explorer:reveal-active-file command

summary: File Explorer plugin that auto-reveals the active file in the sidebar when switching files, without moving keyboard focus out of the editor.
